verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents an official `pplx` command-line interface with its own docs section. It runs web search and returns query-relevant snippets as structured JSON, explicitly aimed at shell pipelines and coding agents, so the core AI-native CLI story is delivered by first-party tooling. missing for 10: evidence the CLI covers more than the Search API (e.g. Agent API/Sonar answers, MCP or admin tasks), independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
